examples.title: Brighten the selected image
examples.code:
# Add a Grade after the selected node and raise its overall level.
source = nuke.selectedNode()

grade = nuke.createNode("Grade")
grade.setInput(0, source)
grade["multiply"].setValue(1.25)

examples.title: Grade only the red channel
examples.code:
# Restrict the correction to red instead of changing the full image.
source = nuke.selectedNode()

grade = nuke.createNode("Grade")
grade.setInput(0, source)
grade["channels"].setValue("red")
grade["multiply"].setValue(1.2)

examples.title: Link gain to another Grade
examples.code:
# Keep this Grade's multiply value synchronized with Grade1.
grading_copy = nuke.createNode("Grade")
grading_copy["multiply"].setExpression("Grade1.multiply")
